description: Return the channels Telegram itself recommends alongside a given channel — its own topical judgement, not a keyword match, so it surfaces channels that share an audience without sharing vocabulary. The way to discover channels whose names you do not already know: start from one you do and walk outward. Large channels return roughly a dozen; small or very new ones return none.

channel.description: Public channel: @handle, bare handle, or a t.me link. Private channels are not readable.

enrich.description: Fetch each result’s exact subscriber count. Costs one API call per result. Default false.

format.description: Output shape. "markdown" is compact prose for a model to read; "json" is the raw API response. Default "markdown".

name: telegram_similar_channels
title: Channels Telegram considers similar
